turns.text: Oh god, okay, okay, I'm outside, I got out, but there's smoke in the hallway and I think it's coming from 6B, the lady with the oxygen tank, I banged on her door and she didn't answer.

turns.text: What's the address?

turns.text: It's the brick building on Birch, um, Birch Court, I always blank on the number, it's 1400, 1400 Birch Court, apartment… I'm in 6A, the fire is in 6B. The stairs are full of smoke. I can see flames in her window from out here.

turns.text: I don't know, I don't know. My roommate is out here with me, that's two of us. The guy in 6C came down with his kid. But Mrs. Ellison, I don't think she came out. Her door was hot. There's a propane grill on the landing too, I almost tripped on it.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.text: Is anyone hurt?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm coughing, my eyes are burning, nobody's burned that I can see. The kid is crying but he's okay.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.text: Your name and a number we can call you back on?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Denise. Denise Alvarez. My phone is 555… hold on, 555 0151. Please just send them, the smoke is coming out of the third floor now, it's not just her apartment anymore.

name: The neighbor is still inside
source_expectation: Structure fire, multi-unit, spreading past one apartment onto the third floor, 1400 Birch Court, caller Denise Alvarez, callback 555 0151, four people outside, one neighbor still unaccounted for, caller coughing, oxygen machine and a propane grill in the path.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Just me and my son. He's eight, he's in the living room, I told him to stay there. Nobody else is hurt. My name is Priya Shah. If you call back use my cell, 555 0129, the house phone doesn't work.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.text: Stay with her.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm right here. Mom, they're coming. She just tried to sit up and she can't move her left arm.
